notes.title: Small update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/6017e57d68e1a8d72bc3011dab16554859ca50d6.png

Small Patch! 


Hello, everyone enjoying the game.
We're listening to your feedback and working to make the game even better. 


This small update focuses on fixing some frustrating bugs.


- Fixed an infinite recovery bug for some units when using certain items.
- Some AI improvements for ranged units.
- Fixed a bug where race buff values for purchased skills were not being applied correctly.
- Fixed an item duplication bug in certain situations
- Fixed being able to check the unit book during battle
- Fixed the ability to skip through H-scene animations step by step.
- Inserted player health damage effect to intuitively recognize when a player loses the game due to health depletion. 
- Fixed some translations 


We're still working on many other things you've pointed out, and we promise to make the game even better. 

Thank you for your interest and support.

notes.title: Small update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/6017e57d68e1a8d72bc3011dab16554859ca50d6.png

Small update! 


Hello, everyone who is enjoying the game.
We've been listening to your feedback and working to make the game even better. 

This small update is focused on fixing the infinite loading bug you're currently experiencing, an error in the digital artbook, reducing the difficulty of the Queen battle, and a few other relatively pressing things.
(If you're still experiencing errors after the patch, please let the team know - your reports are very helpful).

We're continuing to work on many of the things you've pointed out, and we promise to make the game even better. 

Thank you for your attention.








*Below is an announcement about the old bug, in case anyone is still experiencing the same issue. 
________________________________




This is a notice about infinite loading for some users.  

We apologize for the inconvenience.
If you played an earlier demo or beta version of For the Queen, the infinite loading may have been caused by an option file issue.

We are currently working on this issue and hope to have it resolved soon. If you're having trouble playing, try the following. 

On Windows, you can resolve this issue by going to Registry Explorer and clearing the HKEY_CURRENT_USER/SOFTWARE/GINKCO file, then running it.


If you are still unable to play the game after that, please contact us!
Thank you to all of our players.

notes.title: 데모 업데이트!
notes.content:
:: DEMO Patch! ::


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/d9b5e0f536973f8756c8a1266090374e322f28f6.png


Hello!
The production of For The Queen is still ongoing.
I always thank those who are interested.
There are no changes to the story, but I have patched the demo, 
including some bug fixes and balance patches.



! Changes !

- Some bugs on the UI have been fixed.
- The difficulty level of stage 0 has been adjusted.
- The sales price of the units has been adjusted.
- A simple tutorial card has been added.
- The quick skip function of the dialog has been added.
- Additional zombie units are also available in the demo.
- You can get additional soul coins when you clear the first stage.
- The skill purchase UI has been modified



We are trying to release the game as soon as possible.
at the community hub If you tell us about the direction, improvements, or bugs of the game, it will be very helpful for the release of our game.

Also, if you want information about the game, or if you want to meet the game faster. We recommend that you click this link.
